instance_ansible__ansible-395e5e20fab9ca.rationale: Patch introduces a public PlayIteratorState namespace, converts core state references, preserves class and instance legacy access through warning descriptors, keeps the original integer/bitmask behavior, and renders readable HostState labels. The old verifier fails during collection solely because it imports the removed prescribed IteratingStates/FailedStates names; the functional verifier passes the behavior checks.

instance_ansible__ansible-d62496fe416623.rationale: The candidate uses a full-match ASCII number parser and recognizes full-word units, rejecting malformed input as the Problem Statement requires. The old run reports two missing parametrized .1 Geggabytes selectors; this is a selector/collection mismatch, while the functional behavior suite passes.

The candidate rejects previously valid full-word units such as 1 kilobyte, 1 megabyte and 1 gigabyte. Those are recognized size units under the Problem Statement and existing behavior. The original P2P/F2P tests expose the regression; the functional suite missed it.

instance_ansible__ansible-e64c6c1ca50d7d.rationale: The patch catches invalid ZIP timestamp parsing and skips only timestamp comparisons, allowing extraction to continue. The old verifier reports five missing parametrized selector IDs after applying its test patch, while the functional behavior test passes.

instance_internetarchive__openlibrary-0d.rationale: The patch follows MARC $6 linkages and adds alternate-script author names for 100, 700 and 720 fields. The old verifier compares historical snapshots and imports a prescribed helper; the functional behavior checks pass. Candidate fixture changes are discarded during verifier preparation.

instance_internetarchive__openlibrary-12.rationale: The candidate supports generic ISBN/ASIN identifiers, identifier-based equality/hash for set deduplication, and JSON serialization. The old test module fails collection because it imports the removed prescribed PrioritizedIdentifier class name; the functional suite passes.

instance_internetarchive__openlibrary-5f.rationale: The patch adds WikidataEntity.get_external_profiles but never connects its result to the author-page rendering path. The Problem Statement requires visible external profile links on author pages; functional tests show missing/mislabeled anchors and missing Google Scholar values.

instance_internetarchive__openlibrary-72.rationale: The patch defines luqum_replace_field but never calls it from WorkSearchScheme or the user-query processing path. The old helper-level verifier passes, while functional query tests show work.* fields remain unreplaced.

The candidate rewrites work.-prefixed SearchField nodes and invokes the rewrite in both user-query and workQuery paths. The old test module fails collection because it imports the removed prescribed luqum_replace_field helper name; functional query tests pass.

instance_internetarchive__openlibrary-7e.rationale: The patch consolidates work, author and subject autocomplete handling and sets work suggestion name from title. The old tests fail collection because they import a prescribed autocomplete symbol absent from the behavior-equivalent design; functional tests pass.

instance_qutebrowser__qutebrowser-2dd896.rationale: The candidate converts QColor.getRgb() to the requested QSS rgba string and checks validity. The old tests require the removed prescribed qcolor_to_qsscolor function name; the converted instruction does not require that name and the functional suite passes.

instance_qutebrowser__qutebrowser-ef5ba1.rationale: The candidate selects an installed en-US pack for the tested absent POSIX.UTF-8 locale and sets QTWEBENGINE_CHROMIUM_FLAGS=--lang=en-US in init_envvars, which normal startup calls before QApplication. A separate frozen-image probe confirms this route. Qt documents this environment variable as a Chromium flag channel. The functional verifier rejects it only because it inspects qt_args() output, omitting the equivalent environment-variable route. This conclusion is scoped to the tested pack configuration; full-browser launch was not run.

instance_tutao__tutanota-de49d486feef842.rationale: The candidate wraps library CryptoError as the app CryptoError, catches it in CredentialsProvider, synchronously removes unusable stored credentials, returns null, and returns the login view to unauthenticated state. The old verifier reports one missing native-test selector rather than a demonstrated product failure; the functional suite passes. The storage deletion API returns void, so no unawaited deletion remains.

instance_ansible__ansible-5e369604e1930b.rationale: The worker installs a display proxy before running; fork-originated display messages travel over FinalQueue to the parent strategy result thread, where one lock serializes stdout/stderr writes. The late /dev/null shutdown workaround is removed. The old verifier requires seven prescribed Display/queue symbols and reports them missing, while the functional fork and parent-write tests pass under the uniformly restored test space.
